description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling recurrence-related date operations, including parsing date strings, formatting Date objects, and generating current timestamps.

classes.name: RecurrenceUtil
classes.description: A utility class for parsing, formatting, and handling date recurrence operations.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Converts a date string into a Date object based on its length and format.

methods.name: parseDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of date strings into a list of Date objects.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on its time components.

methods.name: formatDateList
methods.description: Converts a list of Date objects into a list of formatted date strings.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current time in milliseconds since epoch.
